definitions.explanation: A person's skill level or capacity to accomplish something, often evaluated in a professional or competitive context. Implies proven or demonstrable ability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{力量|りきりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧だ。
⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{力量|りきりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われている→問う：02299_tou⟧。
examples.english: His competence as a leader is being questioned.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}させる→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{力量|りきりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{底上|そこあ}げ→底上げ：12586_sokoage⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To make this project succeed, we need to raise the overall capability of the team.

notes: Common collocations: {力量|りきりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われる→問う：02299_tou⟧ (one's ability is tested/questioned), {力量|りきりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧ (to demonstrate one's ability), {力量|りきりょう}{不足|ぶそく} (lack of ability). Often used when assessing someone's suitability for a role or task. Related: ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (ability — more general), ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧ (real ability — emphasizes what someone can actually do vs. credentials), ⟦{手腕|しゅわん}→手腕：07466_shuwan⟧ (skill/prowess — emphasizes practical skill in handling matters).
